assembly_steps: Identify the exact modules and male header geometry; pre-program and test every controller before soldering.
On H2 DevKitM-1 v1.3, remove R7 and verify USB-UART TX isolation. Retain the matching RX23/TX24 image.
Temporarily wire all functions and network updates. The two-sided relocation does not change the pin map or firmware.
Dry-fit both faces and measure factory spacer gaps, underside parts, opposing tail heights and ceiling-facing plug clearance.
Complete the entire ceiling-facing back first: WIZ850io, J1–J7, D1–D3 and R1–R2. Solder from the front, then trim, inspect and electrically check all joints while visible. Leave J8/J9 unpopulated.

Only then fit front U1–U3 and solder their pins from the rear. Every front-module solder land must remain accessible with the rear already populated. Deep opposite-side overlap is permitted after the access and measured-clearance checks.
Inspect and test every rail and net for continuity and unwanted contact, including after gentle connector loading. Check loaded Nano VIN and 3V3.

Print the rail coupons and measure the populated stack first. On the bench, fit and adjust the base floor hardware and the separate jack stop; underside screw-head projection must be at most 3 mm. Install the 4 mm ceiling spacing frame before mounting the base. Load the PCB normally into the open edge supports, retain it at H3, then close the cover against its hard stops. Provide cable restraint without loading the WIZ header joints.
Commission all services together and verify network updates, interrupted updates, power cycling, thermal behavior and RF range before mounting permanently.
manufacturing_claim: One current custom PCB layout; finished vendor modules and external harnesses are still separate physical parts.
unproven: Factory pin spacing in Z, trimmed solder-tail height and opposing underside-component clearance
Soldering access and practical assembly order on purchased module variants
Printed rail fit, actual solder growth, jack-load support, housing thermal creep and fit of the generated full enclosure
Loaded Nano VIN operation below the documented external 6 V minimum
H2 R7 isolation, boot straps and network flashing on actual hardware
MG24 update interruption and recovery on actual hardware
RF coexistence, ceiling clearance, range and simultaneous workload reliability
